Gautam Singhania Criticizes Maserati India for Poor Service

Raymond MD Gautam Singhania has publicly criticized Maserati India's service, warning potential buyers. Singhania described his experience as receiving a "lemon" after paying for a luxury car, citing "bad service" and unresolved issues with his Maserati. He cautioned others to "Beware Of The Hype" surrounding the brand's relaunch in India.
